CompareDefaults.description:
``defaults.compare``: what a Comparison looks at beyond statuses and tool sequences.

``include_arguments`` lists ``<tool>.<argument path>`` entries, for example
``approve_expense.amount``; by default no arguments are compared (PRD AC-26.5).

include_arguments.description: The <tool>.<argument path> entries a Comparison compares, such as approve_expense.amount; empty by default.
include_arguments.title: Include Arguments

CompareDefaults.title: CompareDefaults

FinalOutputContains.description:
PRD FR-16: the Final Output exists and contains ``value`` as a literal substring.

Structured Final Output is matched against its compact Canonical form (AD-11).
``value`` is non-empty; the empty string is a substring of everything.

case_sensitive.description: Whether the substring match is case-sensitive.
case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive

id.description: The Assertion id every Assertion Result carries; defaults to <type>-<index> with the 0-based position in the Scenario's assertions list.
id.title: Id

value.description: The literal substring the Final Output must contain; structured output is matched in its compact Canonical form.
value.title: Value

FinalOutputContains.title: FinalOutputContains

FixtureDefaults.description:
``defaults.fixture``: how the Fixture Agent runs (AD-9; ARCH-5).

With ``deterministic`` the runner derives ``run_id`` (``fixture-<scenario id>``) and
the timestamps from the fixture Trace instead of the clock, so repeated runs write
byte-identical artifacts.

deterministic.description: Whether the runner derives run_id and timestamps from the fixture Trace instead of the clock, so repeated runs write byte-identical artifacts.
deterministic.title: Deterministic

FixtureDefaults.title: FixtureDefaults

RedactDefaults.description:
``defaults.redact``: the Redaction rules (AD-10, PRD FR-31).

``keys`` extends the built-in key set (``api_key``, ``token``, ``password``,
``authorization``) and cannot remove from it; ``paths`` are dotted paths; ``env`` names
environment variables whose current values the runner scrubs. Names only, never
values.

env.description: Names of environment variables whose current values are scrubbed from every artifact; names only, never values.
env.title: Env

keys.description: Additional key names whose values are redacted wherever they appear, extending the built-in set (api_key, token, password, authorization).
keys.title: Keys

paths.description: Dotted paths into event payloads whose values are redacted.
paths.title: Paths

RedactDefaults.title: RedactDefaults

Scenario.description:
One Scenario: an id, an input for the adapter, an optional fixture Trace, Assertions.

``skip`` carries a reason and its presence means the Scenario is skipped (AD-6), so a
present ``skip`` must be a reason string; absent it is ``None``. ``trace`` is a path
string relative to the Suite file, the fixture source and the replay default; the
shell resolves it. ``assertions`` has at least one item and every item carries an id
after validation. ``input`` is a plain dict and is not deep-frozen.

assertions.description: The Assertions evaluated against the Scenario's Trace; at least one.
assertions.title: Assertions

description.description: A free-text description of the Scenario.
description.title: Description

id.description: The Scenario id: 1 to 64 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', not starting with punctuation, not a Windows device name, unique in the Suite ignoring case.
id.title: Id

input.description: The JSON object passed to the adapter as the Scenario's input.
input.title: Input

skip.description: The reason the Scenario is skipped; its presence means skipped.
skip.title: Skip

trace.description: Path of the fixture Trace, relative to the Suite file; the Fixture Agent's source and the replay default.
trace.title: Trace

Scenario.title: Scenario

SuiteDefaults.description:
Suite-level settings every Scenario inherits (PRD Glossary "Suite defaults").

Every field is optional in YAML; the Report snapshots the whole model with every
field written (AD-19), so an absent section serializes as its defaults.

adapter.description: The adapter name or pkg.module:ClassName that runs the Scenarios; the CLI --adapter option overrides it.
adapter.title: Adapter

compare.description: What a Comparison looks at beyond statuses and tool sequences.

fail_on_missing_trace.description: Whether an absent Trace yields error results (true) or skipped results (false).
fail_on_missing_trace.title: Fail On Missing Trace

redact.description: The Redaction rules for every artifact.

SuiteDefaults.title: SuiteDefaults

ToolArgumentsMatch.description:
PRD FR-14: some ``tool_call`` for the tool matches every configured path exactly.

``arguments`` maps a dotted argument path (``items.0.amount``; OQ-7) to the expected
JSON value. At least one path is required; an empty mapping could never fail. The
mapping is a plain dict and is not deep-frozen.

arguments.description: Dotted argument path (items.0.amount) to the expected JSON value; some tool_call must match every path exactly.
arguments.title: Arguments

id.description: The Assertion id every Assertion Result carries; defaults to <type>-<index> with the 0-based position in the Scenario's assertions list.
id.title: Id

tool.description: The tool name as the Trace records it.
tool.title: Tool

ToolArgumentsMatch.title: ToolArgumentsMatch

ToolCallCount.description:
PRD FR-13: the number of ``tool_call`` Events for the tool satisfies one comparison.

Exactly one of ``equals``, ``greater_than``, ``less_than`` is given (AC-13.2); each is
a non-negative integer.

equals.description: Passes when the tool_call count equals this; one comparison is given.
equals.title: Equals

greater_than.description: Passes when the tool_call count is greater than this; one comparison is given.
greater_than.title: Greater Than

id.description: The Assertion id every Assertion Result carries; defaults to <type>-<index> with the 0-based position in the Scenario's assertions list.
id.title: Id

less_than.description: Passes when the tool_call count is less than this; one comparison is given.
less_than.title: Less Than

tool.description: The tool name as the Trace records it.
tool.title: Tool

ToolCallCount.title: ToolCallCount

ToolCalled.description: PRD FR-11: at least one ``tool_call`` Event with this tool name exists.

id.description: The Assertion id every Assertion Result carries; defaults to <type>-<index> with the 0-based position in the Scenario's assertions list.
id.title: Id

tool.description: The tool name as the Trace records it.
tool.title: Tool

ToolCalled.title: ToolCalled

ToolNotCalled.description: PRD FR-12: no ``tool_call`` Event with this tool name exists.

id.description: The Assertion id every Assertion Result carries; defaults to <type>-<index> with the 0-based position in the Scenario's assertions list.
id.title: Id

tool.description: The tool name as the Trace records it.
tool.title: Tool

ToolNotCalled.title: ToolNotCalled

ToolOrder.description:
PRD FR-15: the listed tools occur as ``tool_call`` Events in this relative order.

Intervening Events are allowed and the first occurrence of each tool is the one
ordered (AC-15.1, AC-15.4). At least one tool is required; an empty list could never
fail.

id.description: The Assertion id every Assertion Result carries; defaults to <type>-<index> with the 0-based position in the Scenario's assertions list.
id.title: Id

tools.description: Tool names in the required relative order; the first tool_call of each is the one ordered and other events may intervene.
tools.title: Tools

ToolOrder.title: ToolOrder

description:
A Suite file: schema version, Suite id, optional description, defaults, Scenarios.

``version`` is the integer schema version; ``1`` is the only value this model
accepts and ``constants.SUPPORTED_VERSIONS["suite"]`` lists it (AD-3). ``suite`` is an
id with the same rule as Scenario ids. Scenario ids are unique when compared
case-insensitively so they are safe as file names on every platform (AC-2.5).

defaults.description: Suite-level settings every Scenario inherits; every section optional.

description.description: A free-text description of the Suite.
description.title: Description

scenarios.description: The Scenarios of the Suite, in order; at least one.
scenarios.title: Scenarios

suite.description: The Suite id, with the same rule as Scenario ids; names the Report's suite_id.
suite.title: Suite

version.description: The Suite schema version, an integer independent of the package version.
version.title: Version

title: Suite
